2026-03-01.title: The King is Coming
2026-03-01.verse: On that day the Lord their God will deliver them as the flock of his people, for they are the precious stones of a crown sparkling over his land. How precious and fair! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the young women.
2026-03-01.observation: There are many layers to this chapter. The first layer is that the King was truly coming. His name is Jesus. Jesus came in the fullness of time and ransomed Israel, just not in the way they thought. He did not come to merely save their national status among the nations. He came to set their souls free and usher in an eternal kingdom. The second layer is that the King will come again. God’s Word promises that Jesus will return. While there are many theologians who differ on when and how, no orthodox Christian denies the reality that Jesus will return. Therefore, there is always hope for tomorrow. The third layer is the example this text gives. If Jesus came the first time, He will come again. Not only will He come in the clouds, He will come into our lives. He promises to walk with us through every valley and every mountain. We can trust in Him.
2026-03-01.application: Trust in the Lord to walk with you today. Think about the beauty of the Lord coming one day for us all.
2026-03-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being here now and for coming again for us all in the future.

2026-03-02.title: The Lord Answers Prayer
2026-03-02.verse: Ask the Lord for rain in the season of the late spring rains—the Lord who causes thunderstorms—and he will give everyone showers of rain and green growth in the field.
2026-03-02.observation: Prayer is an amazing thing. We do not always understand how prayer works. Prayer is the way we fellowship with the Lord. Prayer is the way we tell God all that is going on in our lives. Prayer is how we ask God for all the things we need. God has a sovereign plan for our lives. At the same time, when we pray, the Lord answers our prayers. How does that work within the sovereign plan of God? It’s not always so clear. What we do know is that God tells us to pray. When we pray, God does amazing things. So pray, trust God, and watch what happens.
2026-03-02.application: Have you prayed about what you are worried about?
2026-03-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to hear us when we pray.

2026-03-03.title: The Good Shepherd
2026-03-03.verse: The Lord my God says this: “Shepherd the flock set aside for slaughter.
2026-03-03.observation: In this passage, the Lord instructs Zechariah to live out an illustration as an example to Israel. In one season, he is to be a good shepherd over bad sheep. In another season, be a bad shepherd. The illustration was to represent how God had been gracious to sheep even if they did not deserve it. However, if they did not accept His rule, God would give them shepherds that did not care for them. One of the key differences between this illustration and reality is that God never gives up on us. However, if we refuse His rule, He will let us be led by those who do not always care for us in the best way. It’s almost like a child asking over and over to touch a hot stove. The parent will say not to, even if the child persists. But, if the child persists over time, the parent may eventually stop standing in the way. Some lessons are only learned the hard way. We should never let this be us. Instead, we should trust the Lord and let that be enough.
2026-03-03.application: Where do you need to trust the Lord today?
2026-03-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being our Good Shepherd.

2026-03-04.title: Where Does Your Strength Come From?
2026-03-04.verse: On that day,” says the Lord, “I will strike every horse with confusion and its rider with madness. I will pay close attention to the house of Judah, but will strike all the horses of the nations with blindness. Then the leaders of Judah will say to themselves, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are a means of strength to us through their God, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.’
2026-03-04.observation: Where does your strength come from? In this passage, God is telling the people through Zechariah that the day will come when their confidence will come from knowing God is with them. Their strength will come from the Lord. When you go through hard times, do you tend to lean on your own strength and trust in yourself to make things happen? I do. I struggle to lean on the Lord, tell Him about all that’s happening through prayer, and trust Him to ultimately work things out. Only after it is over do I look back and realize God was in control the whole time. I promise myself that I will remember that next time, and the cycle begins again. How about you? How much less would you worry if you put your trust in the Lord? How much more would your confidence soar if you humbly served Him because you know He is moving? My prayer is others will say of us, “Look at how their strength comes from the Lord.”
2026-03-04.application: Where, in your life, do you need to lean on the Lord today?
2026-03-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being more than enough for us.

2026-03-05.title: Purification Through Difficulty
2026-03-05.verse: Then I will bring the remaining third into the fire; I will refine them like silver is refined and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name and I will answer; I will say, ‘These are my people,’ and they will say, ‘The Lord is our God.’
2026-03-05.observation: I heard someone say that it is common for people who have massive heart surgery to go through a season of experiencing nightmares during the recovery process. It is so terrible and so common that there are support groups for people recovering from heart surgery. The groups are focused toward dealing with the mental strain. It is important to realize that the body does not understand the experience it just endured as a surgery that saved its life. All it knows is that something catastrophic happened. The body was opened, the heart was exposed, and now things are different. The body does not know the difference between a catastrophic accident and a life-saving surgery. Therefore, it almost short-circuits in a way. Eventually, it begins to heal and recover. I think we are all like that when it comes to difficult seasons. We cannot always tell the difference between bad things happening and bad things bringing about God’s ultimate good for His glory and our recovery from the effects of sin. It’s only later that we look back and see it was all for His good.
2026-03-05.application: Is there a place in your life where God is doing more good than you probably see right now?
2026-03-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always doing more than we can see.

2026-03-06.title: Come to the Lord
2026-03-06.verse: But if any of the nations anywhere on earth refuse to go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, they will get no rain.
2026-03-06.observation: Rain was the most important thing, other than sunlight, for the success of the crops. They needed rain for the crops to grow and they needed the crops to sustain their lives. God is saying that all that you need to sustain you in this life comes from Him. When you do not make God a central part of your life, you may have other things, but you will not have the most important things. This can cause great confusion in our lives. There are people who do not follow God that appear to have “everything” in life. The truth is that they possibly do have many things that money can buy. However, what we do not see is that they often struggle because they do not have all the things that money cannot buy. When we come to the Lord, He gives us what we did not know we needed, but our hearts were always longing for such as love, joy, peace, goodness, kindness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.
2026-03-06.application: Bring your whole self to the Lord and find your strength in Him today.
2026-03-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to continually place our hope in You.

2026-03-07.title: Understand His Greatness
2026-03-07.verse: and what is the incomparable greatness of his power toward us who believe, as displayed in the exercise of his immense strength. This power he exercised in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms
2026-03-07.observation: One of Paul’s prayers for the church was to understand just how great the power of God is. This doesn’t mean we have an actual knowledge of how God’s power works or have an exact knowledge of when and where God moves. Paul is saying, “I want you to understand how great God is. Whatever you think is possible, He’s greater. Understand that He is greater and more amazing than you can imagine.” He is hoping we would have a bigger vision of who God is than we currently do. He wants us to take God out of the box we have placed Him in and allow Him to overwhelm our expectations. We learn about God’s ways by reading His Word. He has described Himself there. That’s why we read His Word. We learn about Him and sit back in awe and wonder.
2026-03-07.application: Never think you have God fully figured out. Spend time thinking about how God is even bigger than your imagination can hold.
2026-03-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being greater than our capacity to understand. Omnipresent. Omnipotent. Omniscient. Omni-Benevolent.

2026-03-08.title: God’s Refrigerator Art
2026-03-08.verse: For we are his creative work, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works that God prepared beforehand so we can do them.
2026-03-08.observation:
When my daughters were little, they loved to draw pictures. One day, one of them brought me a picture of a badly drawn semi-straight line. I asked what it was supposed to be. She said, “Daaaaad. It’s a castle, of course.” Oh. So I put it on our refrigerator to display this great castle. A few days later, a friend came over and asked what it was. I told him, “Well, it’s a castle of course!” 

He couldn’t see the point because his child hadn’t drawn it. To him, it was a badly drawn semi-straight line. To me, it was a work of art not because of what it was but because of who it represented. This is what Jesus thinks of His church. He calls us His masterpiece. When we look at ourselves, we may not agree. However, God sees something beautiful and worth giving His life for.
2026-03-08.application: See everyone around you today as a precious work of art, beautiful in God’s sight.
2026-03-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for seeing us as worth saving.

2026-03-09.title: The Never Ending Journey
2026-03-09.verse: you will be able to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth, and thus to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, so that you will be filled up to all the fullness of God.
2026-03-09.observation: Paul’s prayer is that we would begin to understand just how big the love of God is. At the same time, he reminds us that we are not going to ever be able to fully understand it. This is one of the things I love about digging in further to God. You can never exhaust this topic. The more you see God, the more you realize you have not even scratched the surface. When you think you have learned it all, you notice there is a whole new way to see His goodness you’ve never even considered before. God is greater than we can ever imagine.
2026-03-09.application: Take time to think about how big God must be to hold the entire universe in His Hands. Then, think about how much bigger He must be than even that.
2026-03-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always blowing our minds. Your greatness never ceases.

2026-03-10.title: Fight For Unity
2026-03-10.verse: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, putting up with one another in love, making every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace. There is one body and one Spirit, just as you too were called to the one hope of your calling,
2026-03-10.observation: We don’t drift toward unity. We drift toward division. Just like a boat flowing with the current, we will always drift toward separating ourselves from others. We have to constantly paddle against the current and fight to stay unified and together. This requires compromise, understanding, forgiveness, and more. But, it is always worth it.
2026-03-10.application: Who do you need to take the first steps toward forgiving?
2026-03-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always forgiving us.

2026-03-11.title: Mutual Submission
2026-03-11.verse: and submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ.
2026-03-11.observation: The New Testament speaks in several places about the proper order of a godly home. This has been a big deal for people who think this, in some way, assigns different levels of value in the eyes of God. That is completely wrong. God likes order. People know where their guardrails and opportunities are when we place things in order. This is what God is up to. When men do their part and women do their part, a home has balance. In order to do this, both have to go “all in” and serve the other.
2026-03-11.application: See a family as a chance to serve each other.
2026-03-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for caring about all things.

2026-03-12.title: Get Fully Dressed
2026-03-12.verse: For this reason, take up the full armor of God so that you may be able to stand your ground on the evil day, and having done everything, to stand.
2026-03-12.observation: Paul is careful to remind us that we need ALL the armor of God in order to still be standing at the end of the battle. Every step we take has already been won by Jesus. We don’t fight for victory. We fight FROM a position of victory. Therefore, we put on all God’s armor, which is His character and goodness toward us. This gives us the strength and assurance we need to be brave and courageous.
2026-03-12.application: Every day, mentally put on God’s armor. This reminds you of how you are fully prepared to walk in victory.
2026-03-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for fighting every battle before us, then walking us to victory.

2026-03-13.title: Do You Realize How Loved You Are?
2026-03-13.verse: I have shown love to you,” says the Lord, but you say, “How have you shown love to us?” “Esau was Jacob’s brother,” the Lord explains, “yet I chose Jacob
2026-03-13.observation: In some relationships, there is a certain amount of insecurity that requires people to constantly prove their love. They believe love needs constant affirmation. One of the greatest defenses against this is for someone to take the time and show the steady stream of love over time. This is usually because the one claiming to not be loved has forgotten the past acts of kindness. God is doing this for the nation of Israel. They are doubting His love. God’s response is to say, “Look at your past. If that is not love, tell me what is. Also, tell me what has changed.” Sometimes, when God does not appear to be doing what we want or in the timing we want it, we can feel as though God is not being faithful. To that, God could be saying, “Look at your past. Look at how I have been with you. Has anything changed?” The answer would be no. It is okay to hurt when bad seasons come. It is okay to wish for better days. But, don’t let that drive doubt into your mind. God is faithful. If you doubt that, look at your past.
2026-03-13.application: Trust God and hold tightly to your relationship with Him. He is better to us than we realize.
2026-03-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so good to us.

2026-03-14.title: The Purpose of God’s Covenant
2026-03-14.verse: My covenant with him was designed to bring life and peace. I gave its statutes to him to fill him with awe, and he indeed revered me and stood in awe before me.
2026-03-14.observation: Have you ever thought about why we have most of what is present in God’s Word? If you think about it, all we truly need to know is the state of our sin, our need for a Savior, and how to get to the Savior. If that is the case, why do we need all the rest? God’s Word provides the answer. The reason for the rest is to bring life and peace to our lives. God’s Word is for us. He doesn’t need it. He is already perfect in all things. God’s Word gives us the ability to find Him in all things so we can find life and peace.
2026-03-14.application: Do you read God’s Word just to acquire knowledge or do you read God’s Word to let it change you from the inside out?
2026-03-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being interested in all of us and bringing complete peace.

2026-03-16.title: Putting God to the Test
2026-03-16.verse: Bring the entire tithe into the storehouse so that there may be food in my temple. Test me in this matter,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, “to see if I will not open for you the windows of heaven and pour out blessing for you until there is no room for it all. Then I will stop the plague from ruining your crops, and the vine will not lose its fruit before harvest,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. “All nations will call you blessed, for you indeed will live in a delightful land,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
2026-03-16.observation: There is an old phrase that says, “The proof isn’t in the pudding. The proof is in the eating.” The point of this is that, just like you don’t know how good something tastes until you try it, you don’t know the value of something until you put it to the test. God is saying this to the people. He is saying, “Try my ways and watch what happens. You want me to prove Myself to you before you obey Me. It’s the other way around. Obey Me and watch what happens.” God is good. Therefore, we can trust Him even when we don’t always understand His ways.
2026-03-16.application: Live for God by obeying His Word and watch what happens.
2026-03-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being trustworthy.

2026-03-17.title: Those Who Follow Find Joy
2026-03-17.verse: But for you who respect my name, the sun of vindication will rise with healing wings, and you will skip about like calves released from the stall.
2026-03-17.observation: I was talking to my daughter the other day and she said one of her professors did something to ensure students came to class. For those who followed the instructor’s instructions and showed up for class, they became exempt from an assignment. Those who did not show up for class did not hear the announcement so they had to do the assignment. The only price was to do what the instructor said and the reward followed. So much of God’s Word proclaims the same. Those who follow the Lord receive the peace and joy that can only come from the Lord. However, you have to “show up” and follow in order to receive.
2026-03-17.application: Follow the Lord and watch what happens.
2026-03-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us the way to life.

2026-03-18.title: God Finishes What He Starts
2026-03-18.verse: For I am sure of this very thing, that the one who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Christ Jesus.
2026-03-18.observation: It’s not always very hard to start something. There’s excitement about the promised reward it offers such as losing weight, managing time better, getting to a new position in life, etc. The beginning is fun. The journey is hard. Once the new wears off, it is easy to forget why we are going somewhere and begin to resent the journey. However, God doesn’t do this. He is interested in the long game. His intentions extend even past this life and into eternity. He never gives up on us and He never grows weary of the process. He will finish what He starts.
2026-03-18.application: Allow God to do His perfect work in you and stay faithful to His process of growing you into something completely free, whole, and mature.
2026-03-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so faithful.

2026-03-19.title: Self-Differentiation
2026-03-19.verse: Instead of being motivated by selfish ambition or vanity, each of you should, in humility, be moved to treat one another as more important than yourself. Each of you should be concerned not only about your own interests, but about the interests of others as well.
2026-03-19.observation: Self-Differentiation is a big word that means “all good, all by yourself.” This doesn’t mean being prideful or being independent of God. It’s seeing that God made you without the need to impress others. Other people’s opinions do nothing to how God feels about you. When we can become independent of “needing” others, we are then able to be interdependent. This means we can choose to walk with others. Then, the giving and receiving from one another becomes healthy and good. This text talks about having a healthy emotional relationship with others. We don’t have to be selfish, because we don’t consider ourselves to be better or worse than others. Just different. We don’t have to impress others, because we are already accepted by God. We can be “humble,” which doesn’t mean thinking less of yourself. It means thinking of yourself less often. You can see the strengths of others, because you are not threatened by them.
2026-03-19.application: Realize that in Christ you are already accepted, secure, and significant. This gives you the space to love people without needing anything from them.
2026-03-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us for who we are. You are always healing every broken place.

2026-03-20.title: I Want to Truly Know God
2026-03-20.verse: My aim is to know him, to experience the power of his resurrection, to share in his sufferings, and to be like him in his death,
2026-03-20.observation: You don’t truly know someone until you marry them. I’ve even heard this from someone who once lived with someone before marrying them. He said there is something different about being married and realizing you are now joined with this person completely. This is an example of what God wants with us. He doesn’t want a dating relationship where we see each other on occasion. He wants to be close with us for the long term. Examine your relationship with God. Do you see Him as your Sunday date or as your daily companion?
2026-03-20.application: Take a “next step” to get closer to God. Ask Him to be with you in every moment.
2026-03-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the truest friend.

2026-03-21.title: Look for the Joy in All Things
2026-03-21.verse: Rejoice in the Lord always. Again I say, rejoice!
2026-03-21.observation: There is a difference between joy and happiness. Happiness is based on the “happenings” of life. If the sun is shining, I’m happy. If it’s raining, I’m unhappy. Joy is about something deeper. It is a position of the heart that God is in control and is always working, even if I don’t see Him. Paul tells us to always be full of that deeper reality that isn’t affected by what we can see. Always look for God working in your life and live in such a way that the outward changing things don’t move you off your joy.
2026-03-21.application: Find three things you are thankful for today.
2026-03-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always moving and working in our lives.

2026-03-22.title: The Greatest Miracle
2026-03-22.verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
2026-03-22.observation: When you think about it, the first verse is easily the greatest in the entire Bible. If God can create the heavens and the earth, then anything else is possible. When we also realize that the book of Genesis was written to the recently liberated people of Israel, we realize that God was correcting any false theology they had picked up in the nation of Egypt. Creation was not a group effort. Creation was by the one and only sovereign God. That reminds us that our King reigns supreme, He is above all, and nothing is impossible with Him.
2026-03-22.application: Think about the greatness of God. Everything you see has been created by God.
2026-03-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for calling us Your special creation out of all the wonders You have made.

2026-03-23.title: God’s Hope of Innocence
2026-03-23.verse: The man and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.
2026-03-23.observation: In the beginning, God’s plan for His people was to live in innocence. We were not supposed to have to be concerned with sin, shame, or anything that would bring guilt upon our lives. It was sin that caused us to think negatively about ourselves and others. When we receive salvation, we begin the journey back to the state of innocence God intended for us.
2026-03-23.application: Is there a place in your life where you think of yourself only in terms of shame? Where do you need God to bring freedom?
2026-03-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for healing us from the inside out.

2026-03-24.title: God’s Plan for Us
2026-03-24.verse: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God moving about in the orchard at the breezy time of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the orchard.
2026-03-24.observation: I heard someone once say that all of the Bible from Genesis 4 through Revelation 22 is an effort to bring people back to Genesis 3:8. There was a time when people spent their days caring for the things God had made and spent time with God Himself every evening. There was an innocent, beautiful closeness that was enjoyed. When sin came in, all that was destroyed. The rest of the Bible is God’s effort to redeem His creation and bring us back to this place of joy.
2026-03-24.application: Have you thought about how we can “fellowship” with God now because of what Christ has done? What if you took a walk with the Lord today?
2026-03-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to know You by washing away our sin.

2026-03-25.title: Be The One
2026-03-25.verse: And a son was also born to Seth, whom he named Enosh. At that time people began to worship the Lord.
2026-03-25.observation: It appears as though humanity started going down a bad path. People began to grow more distant from God. There is a great conversation to be had about why and how important it is for us to teach the next generation to follow the Lord. However, at some point, someone has to be the one to start moving in the right direction. This does not mean you have to be a “world changer,” a “trendsetter,” or a “once-in-a-generation” type person. That’s a lot of pressure. All you need to do is decide that you want to follow the Lord. It does not matter what others are doing. It doesn’t matter if you are the only one. Someone has to be the first in your family or friend group to follow the Lord. Seth decided to change things. He had a son named Enosh, and they began to worship the Lord by name. Will you be the one, too?
2026-03-25.application: Don’t be ashamed to follow the Lord today. Someone has to be the first.
2026-03-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to follow You.

2026-03-26.title: The Goal of Closeness
2026-03-26.verse: The entire lifetime of Enoch was 365 years. Enoch walked with God, and then he disappeared because God took him away.
2026-03-26.observation: I heard someone once say, “You don’t want to be so Heavenly minded that you are no Earthly good.” This is probably true, but I have rarely ever been around anyone like this. I have been around people who are very focused on Heaven, but not to the point they were not of any good on Earth. Actually, I think that the more you have an accurate view of Heaven, the more you will be doing good on Earth. One of the reasons why is because you realize how good God is and you live with the joy of His fellowship. Another reason is that you realize something good is coming and you work in preparation. Finally, one more reason is an accurate view of Heaven steals the fear of what happens after death. Therefore, you no longer live as though you only have this life to find joy. When we get an accurate view of Heaven and make it our goal to walk closely with God, great things happen.
2026-03-26.application: Think about Heaven and walking closely with Him today. What do you love about having God in your life?
2026-03-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to spend eternity with You.

2026-03-27.title: Our Job is Obedience
2026-03-27.verse: And Noah did all that God commanded him—he did indeed.
2026-03-27.observation: I cannot imagine how difficult it would be to even begin to understand the task given to Noah. He is supposed to build a massive boat that will basically be a life raft to save humanity and the animals God created. How do you even begin to start attacking this job? Noah realized the only thing to do was to do what God said. He did not decide to figure it out on his own. He did everything the Lord said. In our lives, we will come across issues that are bigger than us and seem impossible. Our job is not to try and outthink God or figure it out by ourselves. Our job is to figure out what would be most honoring to the Lord and then do that. God will take our best effort and do something amazing.
2026-03-27.application: What is the most God-honoring way you can fulfill your commitments and live your life today? Do that.
2026-03-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us take every single step.

2026-03-29.title: The Lord Shows Mercy
2026-03-29.verse: And the Lord smelled the soothing aroma and said to himself, “I will never again curse the ground because of humankind, even though the inclination of their minds is evil from childhood on. I will never again destroy everything that lives, as I have just done.
2026-03-29.observation: When Noah worshiped the Lord for bringing him through the storm, God shows mercy and says He will never allow another devastating flood like that to destroy the world. Since that time, there have been many localized floods, but none have ever been that devastating again. Many times, it’s not just that we make it through a storm, it is also how we make it through the storm that makes the difference. Noah was not bitter. Noah worshiped the Lord for bringing him through the storm. When we realize God’s mercy despite the difficulties of life, God’s blessing is on us.
2026-03-29.application: No matter what difficulty you face today, take a moment and be thankful. Watch what it does for your soul.
2026-03-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all You are constantly doing in our lives.

2026-03-31.title: Seasons Change Over Time
2026-03-31.verse: The entire lifetime of Noah was 950 years, and then he died.
2026-03-31.observation: Only a couple of chapters ago, the world looked very different from how it does now. In this chapter, God opens up a whole new aspect of life. They are now able to eat meat, but they have to do so in a humane way. Then, even mighty men fall. At last, we realize that even mighty men die. All things change, except for God. It would be hard to believe that someone like Noah was human when you realize what God used him to do. However, all men are mortal and die. Only the Lord is truly righteous and holy. This is important because we have to be careful never to place our heroes on unfair pedestals. Allow them to be human. We still hold them accountable, but we never place our ultimate hope in them. Our ultimate hope is in God.  So, let the seasons change. The Lord stands unmoved.
2026-03-31.application: Are you grieving the loss of a sweet time in your life or are you wishing the current season would change? Don’t worry. All seasons change. What good thing can you be thankful for about today?
2026-03-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your faithfulness in all seasons.
